instrument_pooled.L1_own_axis_ratio_note: heavy-tailed: the degree-6 zonal has kurtosis of order two ten-thousands, so the per-neuron ratio is noise dominated; only the pooled mean is a usable check

metrics.metric_semantics: max(measured matched-count random-axis floor, predeclared materiality bar R2_BAR) divided by the own-axis captured degree-6 energy, both expressed as a fraction of the degree-3-and-above residual energy of the depth-32 readout; LOW means the own-axis zonal family both beats the random floor and clears the materiality bar, HIGH means it does neither
